title: How McGhee's addiction began
summary: Fats gave him a speedball; later cocaine laced with heroin left him with a habit.

story.theme_name: Drink, drugs and the bandstand's casualties
story.community_name: Drugs and drink on the bandstand and the road

blocks.x: Anyway, we're in the early Fifties, and you're doing a lot of these different kinds of things, and going up to Christy's on weekends.
Yeah, on weekends. Well, it was a nice place to play, Christy's was.
Then what?
Well, I worked up there at Christy's until about '55 or '56. Then at that time I was strung out, so...
I remember you telling me the story about how Bird told you not to mess with that stuff that was in the clarinet case...
Yeah, yeah...
But eventually you found out for yourself what it was.
How did that get going?
McGhee (12/1) - 8

Well, I came here once from California when I was living out there, when Bird was out there, and I came here. And I ran into Fat Girl, and he turned me on, you know, with a speedball. That's the first time I'd ever heard about it. I didn't even know what a speedball was. Shit, I hung out with him and I took a shot of that stuff, and I was sick for the next three days.

Finally, I went on to Detroit to play with Jazz at the Philharmonic; I had a gig to play there -- and I played with Norman there. Then I went on into Chicago, and went back to Los Angeles. I said I wasn't gonna do that shit no more. But like, when I came back into New York, I was layin' around not doing anything. Well, you know, I had a tendency to wonder what was really happening. So I sounded that particular stuff, you know, and then I got so I liked it.
Well, you didn't do a speedball again. You just did some horse.
No, I just did some cocaine.
Oh, some cocaine.
Yeah, some cocaine. And that started it into... The cat switched some shit on me one time and gave me heroin instead of cocaine.
It seemed that was kind of a common practice.
Yeah, doing that to the guys.
McGhee (12/1) - 9
I remember Red Rodney telling me that he had some coke and he was supposed to get coke, because he was snorting, and the next thing he had heroin...

Yeah, he had a habit. You get a habit from that... If you don't know. And most guys that hadn't been fooling around with dope don't know what it is anyway. You get all messed like that. That's what happened to me. When I looked around, I had a habit and didn't know it.
Were you snorting it or shooting it?
Well, I was snorting it at first. Then finally, I got the point, "Well, I got to go that way because it takes longer to get high from snorting it than from shooting." So we just switched over.
